    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for j in cols:
        kept=[c for c in cnts[j] if cnts[j][c]==gmax[c]]
        firsts={c:min(i for i in range(h) if g[i][j]==c) for c in kept}

                e=max([i for i in occ if i<nxt], default=None)

            else:
                e=max(occ)
            for i in range(pos,e+1): out[i][j]=c
            pos=e+1
        for i in range(pos,h): out[i][j]=5
    return out
'''
